Messages.Author: ahar...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Correct me if I am wrong, but it is legal to attempt a Grave Robbing
action on a minion you control that is in torpor, right? It just loses
the D type action and either prey or predator are free to block.

If so, what happens in this scenario:

Successful Mind Rape occurs on a vampire in torpor. Next round, gain
control of that Mind Raped vampire. Attempted Grave Robbing on that
vampire is successful...who controls the Grave Robbed vampire?

Thanks in advance.

Alex

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Body:

> Correct me if I am wrong, but it is legal to attempt a Grave Robbing

Messages.Author: ahar...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Is it legal for a vampire to play a Rave on another when attempting to
transfer more blood than the other vampire has space/capacity for? If
so, the excess simply drains off the target vampire, correct?

e.g. vamp A has 8 blood, plays a Rave, and attempts to transfer all 8
blood to vamp B which has 5 blood (capacity 8). Assuming the action was
successful, the end result would be that vamp A is at 0/8 blood and
vamp B is at full 8/8 blood. An excess of 5 blood drains off, correct?

thanks in advance

alex



> [uncited quote snipped]

> Just to be clear, after the player's turn is over (the one playing the
> successful Graverobbing), does the Graverobbed vampire return to its
> original controller? or was the Graverobbing permanent, such that the

Graverobbing changes control permanently. Any transient-control
effects are ended when control is permanently changed.
